name: skill-creator-guide
description: Interviews you about a task you repeat often, then walks you through building a custom skill for it using Cowork's built-in skill creator — no coding required. For packaging a repeating workflow into a one-phrase trigger, when teaching Cowork your personal process from scratch, or during a skill library build session. Use when the user says "create a skill", "teach claude my workflow", "custom skill", "make cowork do this automatically", "automate my process", "I do this every week", or "how do I make a skill".
